alt: 老陶藝師將磨舊的工具交給下一代，接班人承接技藝並帶著年輕學徒創作新的陶器。
scene_prompt: 繼往開來 means carrying forward predecessors' work and creating new possibilities for the next generation, not copying old forms unchanged. A modern community pottery studio with THREE generations. On left an elderly potter warmly hands a well-worn wooden shaping tool to his adult daughter at the central workbench. She holds that inherited tool in one hand and uses the other hand to point out a new creative curved ceramic water pitcher to a teenage apprentice on right, who is making a new related design. Old plain earthenware bowls behind elderly potter visibly develop into elegant contemporary useful ceramics toward the younger side, showing continuity PLUS innovation. Everyone collaborates in one coherent scene, no floating arrows, no diagrams or written labels. Exactly two hands per person, all pottery grounded on shelves or table. Simple hand-building clay, no complex spinning pottery wheel. Warm sincere expressions and active passing of knowledge. Traditional wooden tools alongside a small modern electric kiln far background, closed with no glowing heat or hazards. No logos, words or cultural costume stereotypes.
